scope: Independent exact R2388 scalar integer memory-access corpus source and retained raw-evidence review; root owns delivery.

semantics.method: Independently decoded retained Wasm code/data sections; checked constants, memarg offsets/alignment, access widths and unsigned effective addresses; calculated literal byte results from raw data under official sign/zero-extension and little-endian truncating-store rules. Each exact/blanket module, oracle, cleanup and parity row checked. This is static evidence analysis; no Wasm runtime was invoked.

source_review.Node_oracle: Node WebAssembly engine runs identical module bytes; JS captures fd_write output bytes without arithmetic on loaded/stored values. Literal expectations and Node result must agree before Mixer validation/execution. NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH are removed.
source_review.environment: MIXER_NODE Some is always treated as explicit, including empty/invalid input; PATH discovery occurs only when unset. Absolute regular executable required. Canonical case selector validated before node selection/module construction. All 15 raw denials per run contain ENVIRONMENT_REJECTED and no payload markers.
source_review.worker_structure: Exactly one ignored test; ordinary isolated_case helper re-entered through exact test selector; 24 distinct worker and 24 distinct Node PIDs per parent.
source_review.consuming_cleanup: One execute_swift_command per fresh worker, using default budgets; owning command.rs constructs and consumes a fresh reactor instance. Cleanup checked before semantic assertions on values and traps; all fourteen currents, zero tickets and no invariant checked.
source_review.authorship_dependencies: Literal locally authored case table and existing independently authored structural fixture; no imported Patch/Skip implementation/tests/corpus or external Cargo dependency observed. Node development oracle is already recorded in THIRD_PARTY.yml.

producer_custody.method: Read all per-label commands.json registries and compare exactly to audit-details; inspect unchanged hash-pinned R986 definitions. Rust source waits for Node output and worker output; outer group absence covers descendants. No fresh process probe performed.
